artists.biography:
Spiritualized are a British space rock band formed in 1990 in Rugby, Warwickshire by Jason Pierce (who often goes by the alias J. Spaceman) after the demise of his previous band Spacemen 3. The membership of Spiritualized has changed from album to album, with Pierce — who writes, composes and sings all of the band's material — being the only constant member.

Spiritualized have released seven studio albums. The best known and most critically acclaimed of these is perhaps 1997's Ladies and Gentlemen We Are Floating in Space, which NME magazine named as their Album of the Year.

perplexity.description:
Everything Was Beautiful is the ninth studio album by British rock band Spiritualized, originally released in 2022 via Bella Union. The album continues the band's signature blend of psychedelic rock, gospel, and classic rock, marked by lush orchestration, hypnotic repetition, and emotionally resonant songwriting. Frontman Jason Pierce (J. Spaceman) played a wide array of instruments, crafting a sound that is both expansive and intimate, with themes of love, loss, and transcendence woven throughout.

Musically, Everything Was Beautiful stands as a companion piece to its predecessor, And Nothing Hurt, with both albums drawing from the same demo sessions. Together, their titles reference a line from Kurt Vonnegut’s Slaughterhouse-Five. The album is noted for its seamless fusion of Spiritualized’s various stylistic phases, offering a reinvigorated take on their established sound. Critics praised the album for its ambition and emotional depth, with aggregators Metacritic and AnyDecentMusic? ranking it among the best releases of 2022. Reviewers highlighted its “delirious and exciting” energy and its status as another artistic high point in Spiritualized’s influential discography.
